Step 1: 41 weeks + 7 days = 41 weeks + 1 week = 42 weeks.  
Step 2: 42 weeks = 42 × 7 = 294 days.  
Step 3: Start date: 1858-12-25. Subtract 294 days.  
Step 4: 1858-12-25 minus 25 days → 1858-11-30.  
Remaining days: 294 − 25 = 269 days.  
From 1858-11-30, subtract 269 days:  
November has 30 days, so back 30 days → 1858-10-31 (269 − 30 = 239 left).  
October has 31 days, back 31 → 1858-09-30 (239 − 31 = 208 left).  
September has 30 days, back 30 → 1858-08-31 (208 − 30 = 178 left).  
August has 31 days, back 31 → 1858-07-31 (178 − 31 = 147 left).  
July has 31 days, back 31 → 1858-06-30 (147 − 31 = 116 left).  
June has 30 days, back 30 → 1858-05-31 (116 − 30 = 86 left).  
May has 31 days, back 31 → 1858-04-30 (86 − 31 = 55 left).  
April has 30 days, back 30 → 1858-03-31 (55 − 30 = 25 left).  
March has 31 days, back 25 days → 1858-03-06.
